headline: Microsoft reports measured inference offloading results for mobile robotics
summary: Microsoft Research reports a study of mobile robotic manipulation workloads across onboard, edge and cloud compute, alongside an offloaded-inference capability for its Physical AI Toolchain. The post says lighter onboard GPUs can constrain mapping, navigation and manipulation, while offloading can improve selected task performance and battery life. It also explicitly identifies network latency, bandwidth and remote GPU availability as tradeoffs. The measurements are vendor-reported and cover selected workloads and hardware configurations.
